# Assemble GENERAL GRH two-Selmer dimension conditional on the explicit local routine

Audit a NEW full composition removing the old odd-Galois/good2/small-odd-good promises. Native input monic squarefree integer f, odddegree2g+1, growingg and coefficientbitsB; output dim_F2 Sel^2(J/Q), not rank or points. GRH allowed explicitly. Target bounded-error quantum poly(inputbits,g,log1/eta). The local all-prime routine is currently under separate construction/audit: take its stated native complete-image interface as a CLEAR CONDITIONAL premise, do not pretend it is proved. Your job is pay all remaining global interfaces and return a precise conditional theorem or genuine blocker. Actual corrected Biasse--Song, maximal-order and Stoll descent excerpts are attached.

Proposed chain: factor f overQ, quantum-factor integer discriminants, compute maximal orders for all factors using supplied factorization and actual growing-degree theorem. Let S contain all primes over2disc(f), and infinity separately. For EACH field K, enumerate GRH generating prime ideals norm<=48(log|disc K|)^2; number and bit length are polynomial, handle Q separately. Let T be unionS with these primes. Invoke a COMPLETE compact T-unit free basis with logarithmic error allocation across all fields; never infer completeness from valid returned units. Append the needed roots-of-unity squareclass in EACH factor, not diagonal-1. The source logarithmic free basis excludes torsion.

Concrete torsion repair to check: find largest a with a primitive2^a-th root of unity inK by successive quadratic root/factor tests starting-1; at most1+floor log2[K:Q] successes by cyclotomicdegree. Polynomial factorization over a presented numberfield and heightzero roots should give polynomialbit representatives. This element generates mu(K)/mu(K)^2; oddtorsion contributes nothing. No need enumerate fullrootsgroup or use expensive discrete logs.

Kernel the T\S valuations modulo2. Show this produces ALL L(S,2), not just genuineS-units: T generatesCl(K), so every squareoutsideS class can be corrected by a global square into U_T. Prove injection U_T/U_T²->K*/K*² and the correct mod2basis dimensions. Impose rational norm-square rows including every original primevaluation and real sign. Localize using polynomialsize compact ATOMS/exponent parities, never expanded units. Rational square clearing of atom denominators preserves class; nonzero integralatomalpha has each localvaluation boundedby log2|Norm(alpha)|+1. Pay common localframes and coefficient-to-integralbasis/CRTprecision so all columns are comparable. Distinguish original full-unit valuation rows from parity representatives.

At each p|2disc f use the conditional COMPLETE native local routine; at infinity derive complete real Kummerimage from realroot/sign intervals without enumerating2^g components; outsideS use actual Stoll finite-place theorem. F2linearintersection returns exact Selmerdimension on the global success event. Supply polynomial outputsize, operation counts, coherent-vs-classical interfaces, failure amplification (not exponential product of independent2/3 successes), and strongest same-problem classical comparator. No claimed novelty/speedup or unverified lowerbound. If quantumprimitive source hypotheses or torsion extraction cannot be paid, identify exact issue. Prove or break this entire conditional composition, highestreasoning.

Audit obligations and transcription cautions (editorial, not additional source claims):
- BS Theorem1 is the arbitrary-degree compact S-unit theorem; its stated parameters are n, log|Delta|, |S| and max log Norm(p). Theorem5 is the imported HSP theorem, NOT a standalone exact S-unit basis theorem. Its PDF-checked condition is r<=lambda/36, and its failure bound is mu with logarithmic dependence log(1/mu). Carry that failure through exact recovery and all field factors explicitly.
- Definition8 means alpha=gamma_0*gamma_1^l*...*gamma_k^(l^k), with exact polynomial-size atoms and polynomial k; choose l=2. Section8.1 also charges an LLL-reduced integral basis, phases/logarithms, exact valuations and denominator treatment for fractional S-units. Expanded gigantic products are not an input/output shortcut.
- General factors can have roots of unity beyond +/-1. The paper states U(S)=mu(K) times its free part and displays this again in Algorithm6, but the selected passages do NOT give an explicit separate polynomial-bit torsion-generator extraction algorithm. The audit must pay it and include torsion per factor; free-logarithmic generators alone are insufficient modulo squares.
- Algorithm5's printed output says O is a finite abelian group; the preceding paragraph and Proposition8 identify the intended output as Cl(O). Its displayed r+|S| generator list omits torsion notation (irrelevant to valuations but not to full S-unit squareclasses). Preserve rather than silently promote this shorthand.
- Section8.2 supplies GRH prime ideals of norm<=48*(log|Delta|)^2 and explicitly says their number is polynomial. Pay enumeration/ideal representations and maximal orders, all primes over the native bad-prime set, and norm/sign/local maps. Treat Q separately when Delta=1.
- IB is the NUMBER-FIELD-capable source below. The identically named surface_module_2026/integral_bases is a different Abelard FUNCTION-FIELD paper, not this theorem. IB Theorem1 requires squarefree factorization of the index or discriminant; its Z bound is in word operations in the stated Boolean RAM model. Charge native polynomial coefficient bits and factorization explicitly; the packet does not infer a stronger bit bound by omitting them.

## 2. The concrete dyadic operation

Choose the least odd a such that q=2^a>=1024(g+1)^2; q=O(g^2).
Enumerate affine points over F_q with hbar(x)!=0. Solve the remaining
Artin--Schreier equation by F_2 linear algebra. Lift x to the explicit
unramified degree-a field K/Q_2; the y derivative is a unit, so Hensel
provides a point on the chosen residue branch. Only x is needed for its
norm label in L=Q_2[X]/F.

For analysis, any nonzero chi:J(F_2)->Z/2 quotients the Lang isogeny to
a degree2 etale isogeny J'->J. Pullback along Abel--Jacobi is geometrically
connected: otherwise a based section C->J' would extend by the Jacobian
universal property to a right inverse of that degree2 isogeny. Its genus
is 2g-1. Frobenius telescoping identifies the fiber sign at P in C(F_q)
with chi(Tr(P-infinity)). Two ordinary Weil bounds give at least
(q+1)/2-(4g-1)sqrt(q) negative signs. More than g+1 remain, so excluding
the hbar-zero fibers and infinity cannot remove all of them. Thus all
allowed point traces span J(F_2)/2 without computing the group or its order.

[2](4u)/8=u+2R(u), so multivariate Hensel gives [2]A_2=A_3. Deep formal
points therefore have ZERO Kummer class; deep sampling was falsified.
Use two SHALLOW layers instead. The differential basis is

    omega_j=x^j dx/(2y+h),  0<=j<g.

For each allowed residue point and residue-field basis element u, form
the column (Tr(u*x^j/hbar(x)))_j. They span F_2^g, because a nonzero
polynomial of degree<g cannot vanish at all the available distinct x.

and by 4u on the same Hensel branch. Trace point DIFFERENCES generate
A_1/A_2 and A_2/A_3 respectively. Together with the reduction traces,
their Kummer labels generate all J(Q_2)/2. No half-point algorithm or
formal Jacobian parameterization is used; those appear only in the proof.

All selected points have 2y+h a unit. Therefore v_2(F(4x))=2d-2 exactly,
so no x-theta factor vanishes or approaches a root without a paid bound.
Point norm labels have every normalized component valuation at most

parameter, so dx!=0 in F_2(C). Nakayama then gives the integral relative
